Test Description: Verify PCIe DBI DSP configuration registers for correct reset default values and masked read/write behavior. For each register, write a set of patterns where allowed, read back, and confirm the effective value respects read and write masks. Registers that are non-readable/writable or explicitly excluded are skipped.
Meta Test Description: The test initializes counters def_fail_cnt and wr_fail_cnt to track failures. It performs two major checks: (1) Default value check (chk_rst_val): iterate i=0..CNT-1 over addr_array[i]; if read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000, skip reading. Also skip default check for addresses equal to DBI_DSP_CAP_ID_NXT_PTR_REG, DBI_DSP_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE_STATUS, and DBI_DSP_PL_DEBUG1_OFF. Otherwise, read data_rd = read_reg(addr_array[i]) and compare against default_value_array[i]; increment def_fail_cnt on mismatch. (2) Write/Read check (chk_rd_wr): for each data pattern in {0xffffffff, 0xaaaaaaaa, 0x55555555, 0x00000000, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xffff0000}, write to each address if skip_array[i]==0 and write_mask_array[i]!=0x00000000 via write_reg(addr_array[i], data_wr). Then read back for each i where skip_array[i]==0, write_mask_array[i]!=0x00000000, and read_mask_array[i]!=0x00000000. Compute wr_n = (write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff). Compute exp_val = ((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])). If data_rd != exp_val, increment wr_fail_cnt. A soft_reset_chk() helper exists (writes 0x00000000 to SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS, waits, restores previous value, waits) but is not invoked in test_case(). The test ends with finish(1) if either counter > 0 else finish(0).
Remarks: Registers marked non-readable or non-writable by their respective masks are not accessed. Addresses flagged in the skip list are excluded from write/read checks. Default value verification is intentionally skipped for DBI_DSP_CAP_ID_NXT_PTR_REG, DBI_DSP_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE_STATUS, and DBI_DSP_PL_DEBUG1_OFF. A soft reset helper is defined but not executed.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Initialize the PCIe DBI DSP register test and load the register address list, default values, and access masks. 2) For each readable register, verify the power-on reset value matches the expected default, excluding DBI_DSP_CAP_ID_NXT_PTR_REG, DBI_DSP_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE_STATUS, and DBI_DSP_PL_DEBUG1_OFF. 3) For each configured test pattern, write the pattern to each writable register not marked in the skip list. 4) Read back each register that is both writable and readable and verify the effective value equals: (pattern AND read_mask AND write_mask) OR ((NOT write_mask) AND read_mask AND default_value). 5) Record any mismatches for default and write/read checks and report overall PASS only if no mismatches are detected.
Meta Test Steps / Procedure: - test_case(): call chk_rst_val(); call chk_rd_wr(); if (def_fail_cnt > 0 || wr_fail_cnt > 0) finish(1); else finish(0). - chk_rst_val(): for (i=0; i<CNT; i++): addr = addr_array[i]; if (read_mask_array[i] == 0x00000000) continue; if (addr == DBI_DSP_CAP_ID_NXT_PTR_REG || addr == DBI_DSP_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE_STATUS || addr == DBI_DSP_PL_DEBUG1_OFF) continue; data_rd = read_reg(addr); if (data_rd == default_value_array[i]) PASS else { def_fail_cnt++; log mismatch }. - chk_rd_wr(): patterns chk_val[6] = {0xffffffff, 0xaaaaaaaa, 0x55555555, 0x00000000, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xffff0000}; for each pattern data_wr: (Write phase) for (i=0; i<CNT; i++): addr = addr_array[i]; if (skip_array[i] == 1) continue; if (write_mask_array[i] == 0x00000000) continue; write_reg(addr, data_wr). (Read/verify phase) for (i=0; i<CNT; i++): addr = addr_array[i]; if (skip_array[i] == 1) continue; if (write_mask_array[i] == 0x00000000) continue; if (read_mask_array[i] == 0x00000000) continue; data_rd = read_reg(addr); wr_n = (write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff); exp_val = ((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); if (data_rd == exp_val) PASS else { wr_fail_cnt++; log mismatch }. - soft_reset_chk(): read default_value = read_reg(0x00000000); write_reg(0x00000000, 0x00000000); wait_on(1000); write_reg(0x00000000, default_value); wait_on(1000); (not called).
Impacted Registers: DBI_DSP_TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG; DBI_DSP_TYPE1_STATUS_COMMAND REG; DBI_DSP_TYPE1_CLASS CODE REV ID REG; DBI_DSP_TYPE1_BIST HDR TYPE LAT CACHE LINE SIZE REG; BAR0_MASK_REG; BAR1_MASK_REG; DBI_DSP_SEC LAT TIMER SUB BUS SEC BUS SEC BUS PRI BUS REG; DBI_DSP_SEC STAT IO LIMIT IO BASE REG; DBI_DSP_MEM LIMIT MEM BASE REG; DBI_DSP_PREF MEM LIMIT PREF MEM BASE REG; DBI_DSP_CAP ID NXT_PTR_REG; DBI_DSP_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE STATUS; DBI_DSP_PL_DEBUG1 OFF

Validate PCIe RC0/RC1 DBI control registers, SII transmit/PHY control registers, and selected PHY lane registers for correct reset defaults and masked read/write behavior. For each target register, write known patterns (where writable), then read back and verify against masks; for PHY lanes, access 16-bit fields and verify masked values. SII PHY reset control is asserted prior to PHY lane access.
Meta Test Description: test_case(): prints banner, calls chk_rst_val() then chk_rd_wr(), and exits with finish(err2 || err1). chk_rst_val(): - For i=0..4: read DBI control registers for RC0 (DBI_DSP_MSI_CAP_OFF_08H_REG, MSI_CAP_OFF_10H_REG, DBI_DSP_FILTER_MASK_2_OFF, DBI_DSP_AXI_MSTR_MSG_ADDR_HIGH_OFF, DBI_DSP_UTILITY_OFF) and compare to ctl_default[i]==0x0; increment err1 on mismatch with printf. - For i=0..4: read corresponding RC1 DBI control registers; compare against 0x0; increment err2 on mismatch. - For i=0..2: read SII (RC0) registers (SII_PCIE0_TRANSMIT_HEADER2, SII_PCIE0_TRANSMIT_HEADER3, SII_PHY_CONTROL_23); compare to 0x0; increment err2 on mismatch. - For i=0..2: read SII (RC1) registers (SII_PCIE1_TRANSMIT_HEADER2, SII_PCIE1_TRANSMIT_HEADER3, SII_PHY_CONTROL_23); compare to 0x0; increment err2 on mismatch. - Write SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL = 0x01203000 for both instances (PCIE0 and PCIE1). - For i=0..2: read 32-bit value at phy0_addr[i] (0xE68860B8, 0xE68862B8, 0xE68864B8); if address%4 != 0 then take upper 16 bits (>>16) else lower 16 bits (&0x0000FFFF); compare against phy0_default[i]==0x0; increment err2 on mismatch. - Repeat for phy1_addr[i] (0xE68A60B8, 0xE68A62B8, 0xE68A64B8) relative to phy1_default[i]==0x0 and increment err2 on mismatch. chk_rd_wr(): - Define patterns chk_val[6]={0xffffffff,0xaaaaaaaa,0x55555555,0x00000000,0xA5A5A5A5,0xffff0000} and phy patterns chk_val_phy[3]={0x7baf,0x1,0x003b}. For each j over 3 iterations: • For i=0..4: write chk_val[j] to RC0 and RC1 DBI control registers. • For i=0..2: write (chk_val[j] & sii0_write_mask[i]) to RC0 SII regs; write (chk_val[j] & sii1_write_mask[i]) to RC1 SII regs where write masks are {0xFFFFFFFF,0xFFFFFFFF,0x000F000F} equivalent to 0xF000F. • Re-assert SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL = 0x01203000 for both instances. • For i=0..2: write (chk_val_phy[j] & phy0_write_mask[i]) to phy0_addr[i]; write (chk_val_phy[j] & phy1_write_mask[i]) to phy1_addr[i] where write masks are 0x1FFF each. • Readback/verify: For i=0..4 RC0 DBI regs: expect data_rd == chk_val[j]; on mismatch err1++ with printf. For i=0..4 RC1 DBI regs: same check and err1++. For i=0..2 SII RC0: expect data_rd == (chk_val[j] & sii0_write_mask[i]); err1++ on mismatch. For i=0..2 SII RC1: expect data_rd == (chk_val[j] & sii1_write_mask[i]); err1++ on mismatch. For i=0..2 phy0: read 32b, select 16-bit half by address%4 (upper if odd multiple of 2 bytes else lower), compare ((data_rd & phy0_write_mask[i]) == (chk_val_phy[j] & 0x00001FFF)); err1++ on failure. For i=0..2 phy1: same 16-bit selection and masked compare with phy1_write_mask[i]; err1++ on failure.
